strings.update.deb_hint:
Self-update is not possible for .deb installations (no root actions from the app).
Update via download + apt:
  curl -Lo {path} "{url}"
  sudo apt install {path}

strings.update.note_msi_done: Update v{version} loaded — Windows will ask for installation permission (please confirm), the overlay will be closed and restarted afterwards.
strings.update.note_msi_failed: Installing the update failed (msiexec exit code {code}, {timestamp}) — e.g. UAC denied, MSI error 1603, or a timeout. The previous version was not changed and the overlay was restarted. Check the update log msi-update.log in the temp folder architects-overlay-update; if it fails again, install the update manually from the releases page.

strings.update.note_uptodate: No update found — v{version} is up to date.
